integrity: Complete analytic proof and a self-contained symbolic checker are supplied; the exact two boundary crossings are treated separately, and independent mathematical validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the axial kernel on the five-dimensional four-cylinder intersection is classified; no global zero-free conclusion for the high-parameter range. Routh-Hurwitz and direct monomial integration provide the proof, with separately reproducible symbolic checks. Historical priority is best-knowledge rather than independently certified.
title: Two sharp central Bergman-kernel zero transitions for a four-cylinder intersection
